craft_notes: Sthāyin: the yoking (answer after nineteen negations). Rows: row 3 (always→yoke). Close: All-Lord (sarveśe as landing: the Lord OF ALL closes the tantra). Rejected: closing on negation — kept yoke (niyojayet as the single imperative: the only DO of the text); 'meditate' — kept yoke (yuj as yoking, not sitting).

lines: So indeed: supreme worship, in every state, at all times —
with undivided mind, yoke mind to the Lord as All-Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evameva parā pūjā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā | aikyabuddhayā tu sarveśe mano deve niyojayet

reads_against.argmap: What then is worship? → The answer after twenty negations: nondual mind yoked to the Lord of all, in every state, always — that is the highest worship.
c1_essence: Highest worship is nondual mind yoked to the Lord of all, in every state, always.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling into established holding (stillness that stays)
